title: Measure whether the merging head runs the lane-touched tests a ready PR skips
why: Lane R42 part 2 15:52 CST Nov 12 (record-writer for act 5, PR #2993): a PR moved to ready runs nothing in the lane-touched-tests job; unknown whether checks.yml covers those tests on the merging head.
note: Read one ready PR run and the batch run that merges it; report which lane-touched tests ran where. If none ran on the merging head, file the fix. Decision draft-until-reviewed.
